title: Local development server with real sign-in against the deployed backend
description: npm run dev:cloud serves the working tree at http://localhost:5417 with Vite, signing in through the deployed Cognito client and calling the deployed API and accounts service; nothing is deployed. LOCAL_DEV_ORIGIN joins the production origin in APP_ORIGINS (Cognito callback/logout, API CORS, accounts BFF origin checks). One-time deploy through main. Before deploy: Ryan re-reviews the Google federation policy for the added callback/logout URLs and updates googlePolicyReviewId in accounts/deployment.json. Spec: features/amplify-deployment.feature.
